Maintain sedation and analgesia per current infusions, with goal RASS -2 and pain management.
Continue vasopressor support with norepinephrine for hemodynamic stability, monitoring blood pressure.
Monitor for infection and continue current antimicrobial therapy with piperacillin-tazobactam and vancomycin, checking vancomycin trough levels.
